shared_labels_production_followup.finding: Production RefreshingMetricBlockStore did not override series_shared. The default owned adapter still reached matched_series, so this capture did not establish removal of hot-label string cloning.
shared_labels_production_followup.correctness_validation: All 35 scoped targets, including real Mimir and Prometheus suites, passed. Removing only the wrapper delegation fails the new regression while the other 62 service unit cases pass.

shared_labels_corrected_production_captu.finding: The corrected production wrapper removes owned matched_series from the allocation summary. String-clone totals fell from 6122458 to 4778871 over separate startup-inclusive captures. Series discovery still accounts for 23.54, 32.16 and 37.10 percent of querier self samples; pruning remains below the 0.5 percent report threshold.
shared_labels_corrected_production_captu.next_change: Hash-based series discovery was tested but reverted after no end-to-end gain was demonstrated. Next target: combine instant sample and label discovery to remove a repeated hot-head scan, preserving label precedence, limits and query windows.

series_discovery_experiment.finding: No demonstrated end-to-end efficiency gain. Krabka CPU medians are 0.21777 cores before and 0.21754 after; p99 medians are 33.33 ms before and 36.64 ms after. The p99 ranges overlap, so causality of a regression is unproven. The hash lookup is reverted because a gain is not established.
